meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing with a hybrid engine strategy: resident-kernel engines first - DuckDB plus a resident Python stack (Polars/numpy/matplotlib) in persistent js/py eval kernels where the harness has them, bun/uv one-shots elsewhere - and per-action placement judgment (in-memory vs streaming vs remote-in-place). Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,自动完成统计、聚合与可视化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理CSV/JSON等数据文件并需要快速洞察
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files to produce statistics, aggregations, and charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often process CSV/JSON files and need fast data insights

howto.what: 帮你分析表格类数据:读取 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等文件,做查询、分组、筛选、合并、统计和画图;会先判断数据放内存还是流式处理,并优先使用 DuckDB 和 Python 数据分析工具;回答问题时附带行数和耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析数据、查看数据文件或做汇总等操作时触发;不处理纯文本、配置或简单数学。

say.text: 帮我分析这份 CSV,按类别汇总销售额。
say.note: 它会读取文件并用 DuckDB 做分组汇总。

say.text: 这个 Parquet 文件里有什么?描述一下结构。
say.note: 它会快速给出文件概览。

say.text: 把这两个数据集按 ID 合并,再画个趋势图。
say.note: 它会合并后绘图并做视觉检查。

howto.what_en: Helps analyze tabular data: reads CSV/Parquet/JSON files, performs queries, grouping, filtering, merging, stats, and charts; decides whether to process in memory or stream, preferring DuckDB and Python data tools; reports row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze data, inspect data files, or summarize; not for plain text, configs, or small inline math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum sales by category.
say_en.note: It reads the file and groups with DuckDB.

say_en.text: What's in this Parquet file? Describe the structure.
Merge these datasets by ID and plot a trend.
say_en.note: It joins, plots, and runs visual QA.
